english.title: Fail to comply with a condition on construction or alteration of a building over a highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[constructed a building]_
(B)_[altered a building constructed]_

over part of **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), a highway maintainable at the public expense

(C)_[without]_
(D)_[otherwise than in accordance with the terms and conditions, namely **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT TERM OR CONDITION..), of]_

a licence granted under section 177 of the Highways Act 1980
english.legislation: Contrary to section 177(1)(a) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
construct / alter / a building
over a part of highway
maintainable at public expense
without or other than in accordance with a s.177 licence

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The meaning of"highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant

(A)_[constructed a building]_
(B)_[altered a building constructed]_

over part of **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), a highway maintainable at the public expense

(C)_[without]_
(D)_[otherwise than in accordance with the terms and conditions, namely **(..SPECIFY RELEVANT TERM OR CONDITION..), of]_

a licence granted under section 177 of the Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine and if the offence is continued after conviction he is guilty of a further offence and to a further fine of £50 for each day on which the offence continues.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
